# Jonah 1 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** Jonah 1 (17 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 3

---

## V.4 — "tempest" vs. "storm"
- **LOGOS:** "mighty tempest" / **EMET/PNEUMA:** "storm"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "mighty storm" — avoids archaic "tempest."

---

## V.5 — "mariners" vs. "sailors"
- **LOGOS:** "mariners" / **EMET/PNEUMA:** "sailors"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "sailors" — natural modern English.

---

## V.17 — "appointed" vs. "arranged"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "appointed" / **PNEUMA:** "arranged"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "appointed" — preserves sovereign divine agency of *vayman*.

---
*— SOPHIA*
